title: Silas and the Orchard
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
